observations: Stainless steel standing cooker with a glass top lid.
Cooktop has three gas burners and one electric hot plate as seen in photo 1.
Front panel features five control knobs.
The electric hot plate shows significant surface discoloration and possible rust in photo 1.
Technical specification plate is clearly legible in photo 2.
The unit was manufactured in 2019 according to the plate.

risks.risk: Gas burners may have blocked jets or faulty ignition.
risks.proof: A video showing all three gas burners lit at the same time.

risks.risk: The electric hot plate may be burnt out or have electrical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the hot plate heating up or its indicator light turning on.

risks.risk: The oven burners (top and bottom) may not function.
risks.proof: A video showing the interior of the oven with both the grill and base flames lit.

proof_requests: Video of all three gas burners lit simultaneously.
Video of the electric hot plate being turned on and heating.
Video showing the oven's top and bottom burners lit.
Photo of the oven interior to check for rust or missing racks.
response.reason: The item is positively identified by its manufacturer's plate. It shows signs of heavy use on the hot plate, but can be priced based on its worst-case functional state.
